scope: Design validation only; no deployment, no real PostgreSQL17 migration, no trained-model evaluation.

sql.engine: PostgreSQL 18.6 (PGlite 0.5.16) on wasm32-unknown-emscripten, compiled by emcc (Emscripten gcc/clang-like replacement + linker emulating GNU ld) 6.0.13 (e13ee988ce3d87a738dd8f3661d02223308c412a), 32-bit
checks: DDL creates 24 tables in an isolated database
email uniqueness is case-insensitive
sessions reject invalid secret hashes
model cannot use a dataset of another task
only one active release per environment
release snapshot kinds cannot be swapped
URL release cannot load a spam model
partial result cannot be low risk
failed result cannot be low risk
completed result cannot be unable to analyze
component ordinal is unique within scan and type
calibrated probability is bounded
calibrated output requires calibration version
nonfinite model score is rejected
evidence cannot reference another scan component
terminal feedback requires review evidence
user sample requires reviewer
job success requires result model
scan deletion cascades results but detaches feedback and research submissions
referenced models cannot be deleted
